mapper.sql: customer_id, name, email, phone, region_code, birth_date, joined_at, total_purchase, email_consent_yn, email_consent_at, sms_consent_yn, sms_consent_at, dormant_yn, source, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM customer WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer (name, email, phone, region_code, birth_date, joined_at, email_consent_yn, email_consent_at, sms_consent_yn, sms_consent_at, source) VALUES (#{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{regionCode}, #{birthDate}, #{joinedAt}, #{emailConsentYn}, CASE WHEN #{emailConsentYn} = 'Y' THEN now() END, #{smsConsentYn}, CASE WHEN #{smsConsentYn} = 'Y' THEN now() END, #{source})
mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET name = #{f.name}, email = #{f.email}, phone = #{f.phone}, region_code = #{f.regionCode}, birth_date = #{f.birthDate}, joined_at = #{f.joinedAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
UPDATE customer SET deleted_yn = 'Y', updated_at = now() WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT channel FROM suppression WHERE (channel = 'EMAIL' AND value = #{email}) OR (channel = 'SMS' AND value = #{phone}) ORDER BY channel
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consent_history (customer_id, channel, before_yn, after_yn, source, note) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{channel}, #{beforeYn}, #{afterYn}, #{source}, #{note})
